text: おれの　ほうが　はやく　いっぱい　ポケモン　あつめたのに！

structure.jp: はやく　いっぱい　ポケモン　あつめた

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに after a sentence says the result is unfair or unexpected, with a feeling of complaint. あつめたのに = 'even though I collected them'.

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.explanation: ほうが picks one side as the one that is more or better. おれのほうが = 'I am the one who (does it more)'.
